mapper.select: SELECT id, nickname, IFNULL(signature, '') AS signature FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT id, nickname, password_hash AS passwordHash, IFNULL(username, '') AS level, IFNULL(signature, '') AS signature, status, deleted FROM sys_user WHERE nickname = #{nickname} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user WHERE nickname = #{nickname} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_role (user_id, role_id) SELECT #{userId}, r.id FROM sys_role r WHERE r.role_name = #{roleName} LIMIT 1
